{{Quote|I was afraid you might not come. We are such a small and humble system.|[[Onaconda Farr]] to [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="BombadJedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref>}}
The '''Tyrius system''', also known as the '''Rodia system''',<ref name="EAOC" /> the '''Rodian System''',<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> and the '''Tyrius star system''',<ref name="GG1:ANH">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref> was a five-planet [[Star system/Legends|system]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="TEA" />

The system space is guarded and monitored by the [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]]'s [[Rodian Home Fleet|Home Fleet]], inquiring all incoming vessels.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
